title: [応用] インデックス列順序を検索条件に合わせる
statement: 藩ごとの監査ログを時系列で取得します。SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE tenant_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100; に対し、同じ列でも created_at, tenant_id の順ではtenant絞り込みを活かせません。検索条件に合う列順でインデックスを設計してください。名前は自由です。
starterSql: CREATE TABLE audit_logs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);
solutionSql:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_tenant_created ON audit_logs(tenant_id, created_at);
checkSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_index_list('audit_logs') il WHERE (SELECT group_concat(name, ',') FROM pragma_index_info(il.name) ORDER BY seqno) = 'tenant_id,created_at') AS ok;

benchmark.query: SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE tenant_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;
